data.body: Triage 2026-10-25 (bug sweep): not worked, no code changed. Reproducing needs an MCP client connected to the rebar server and the server-side log of a failing 9-call batch (AC1); this sweep's session has no rebar MCP connection, so neither could be collected. Workaround in use: keep MCP batches to 5 calls or fewer and use the local CLI for wide surveys. Left open.
